sentences.text: The ironing room felt warmer than expected this morning, between 05:00 and 06:00.
The temperature was 21.6 °C, which was above the expected range of 20.7 °C to 21.1 °C.
The sensor noted 'a warmth with no source' during this time.
Since this warmth was unexpected, perhaps checking the heating or for drafts might help.
